note: S01, the whole stack at rest. Real: every live strand's payload and each object's figures, from frame-data.json, the Greenfield record (scripts/greenfield/published.json, summarized beside this station) and integrations.json beside it (the sponsor flows on BSC testnet: addresses and transactions, each read back on a public RPC). The plinth's columns are the 270 mapped batteries of 316 (the rest have no point and are not drawn), height 0.14 m a MW. Lit since they ran on BSC testnet on Nov 25: Flap's season token and vault, OpenFour's graduation, the evaluator on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and its hosted job 1873, the agents' identities and their paid job. After the seal: Cournot's odds, Living Brain's memory (read after 09:12:46 CT) and the paid job, drawn lit with a tick. Designed, drawn as ghosts with dotted lines: CMC's screening of launches, the outcome lamps. Comet speeds and spacing are drawn, not measured.
